objective: Implement low-overhead daily automatic cloud sync for the Timer Android app using GitHub/Gitee repository-based storage, with chunked snapshots, restore support, and settings UI.

context_refs.summary: Build a daily automatic cloud sync feature on top of GitHub/Gitee repository storage, with strong attention to limits, performance, and usability.
Existing JSON backup/export pipeline reused as the sync snapshot payload.
Current local-first product direction that cloud sync extends without introducing a backend.

constraints.data_classification: user productivity data + repository access token

exit_criteria: Chunked snapshot upload and restore implemented
UI entry and status surface added
